description: REPLACE the list of origins allowed to render this project's forms with a publishable key. The list is not merged: anything you leave out stops being allowed, so a live embed can go dark. Read the current list with fillo_get_origins, ASK THE HUMAN FIRST with the exact new list, and pass confirm=true only once they agree. An empty array means any origin. Entries must be bare http(s) origins with no path. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

origins.description: The complete new list, e.g. ["https://app.example.com"]. [] means any origin.

name: fillo_set_origins
title: Set the allowed embed origins
